accepted.compiled_source: Formatting, strict workspace Clippy, workspace tests, native-client/software feature checks and tests, x64/x86 workspace and isolated full-feature SDK builds, native exports and strict C11 header checks, Rust WASM build and matching browser bindings passed. Ignored tests were not run.

standalone_host.scope: Explicit exported Host creation, minimal empty-user observation approval, retained replies/discard/destroy, actual DLL unload while owner thread alive, actual owner OS-thread signal and join before external exit. No users or native windows created.

native_client.scope: Controlled fixture peer, own hidden HWND/wake, snapshot folding/short reads/default-off input, Stop, actual worker completion/Destroy and DLL unload before owner exit. Peer is not the GUI Service.

renderer.scope: Renderer-only own four-color readback and normal close; no physical presentation/full GUI/P1 claim.

gui_pair.reason_limit: Sanitized result does not identify the rejected predicate or record the runtime text encoding. Private GUI buffers were not uploaded.

source_finding.issue: Pair.receipts reads UTF-8 Rust JSONL using default text encoding, while expected steps use explicit UTF-8. Checkpoint37 is the first expected label with U+00B7. A non-UTF-8 default can corrupt equality. Exact historical encoding and rejection predicate are unknown.
source_finding.next_requirement: Explicit UTF-8 receipt decoding and bounded sanitized failure observations require independent source review before a new specimen; no unchanged retry.

not_accepted.later_web_acceptance_extensions: Source-only, unpublished, uncompiled and unrun at this assessment; not covered by this run.
